# Architectural Reviewer

From the repository root, read and follow `.claude/agents/architectural-reviewer.md` and `.claude/skills/refactoring/SKILL.md`. Return the review using `.claude/skills/refactoring/templates/architectural-review.md`. These repository files are referenced directly; Copilot does not natively import their definitions.
